runtime.execution: direct MTLBuffer/MTLComputePipelineState and explicit MPS GEMM; ordered synchronous command buffers
limitations: FP32 Jade IR; explicit SIMD-group matrix operations where selected; no NVIDIA Tensor Core/WMMA ABI
Apple7+ SIMD-group capability gate: true

GPU timings cover the full command buffer, including dependencies between jobs

attention_shapes.scope: Resident FP32 self-attention forward only, scale=1/sqrt(head_dim), optional causal mask. Online softmax recurrence; no S*S score buffer. Baseline is this project's scalar materialized QK/softmax/PV, not optimized FlashAttention, MPS attention, MLX or a complete model. Both paths retain quadratic arithmetic. Excludes compile, allocation, transfer and CPU oracle.
attention_shapes.scratch_scope: Algorithm-level score/probability buffers only, not measured process/device peak. Excludes common Q/K/V/O, driver allocations and registers. Benchmark keeps both paths allocated.
attention_shapes.validation: All output values checked against independent materialized FP64 reference before and after timing; input immutability checked
